title: A metric with no local isometric immersion
description: Seven lessons with a complete proof of OpenAI's theorem (2026) that there is a smooth metric on a square such that no neighbourhood of the centre has a smooth isometric immersion into three-dimensional space. The height equation of an immersed surface; the construction of the metric from small squares that accumulate at the boundaries of disks of negative curvature; the patch obstruction, proved in five lessons: regularity of solutions of the height equation across the curve where the curvature changes its sign (an estimate at a free edge for an equation of mixed type), energy estimates where the curvature is negative, and a rapidly oscillating perturbation of the metric whose effect is measured by a moment and excluded by the theorem of Baire.
